title: Linear continuity criterion for the local LF test space
statement: Let $m,q\geq0$ be integers, $V\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ open, and $\mathscr D(V,\mathbf R^q)$ the LF test space of [def-sfb-local-coefficient-tests], with its fixed-support subspaces $\mathscr D_K$ for compact $K\subseteq V$. Let $W$ be a real topological vector space (addition and scalar multiplication are continuous) that is locally convex, meaning that $0$ has a basis of convex neighborhoods. For every real-linear map $T:\mathscr D(V,\mathbf R^q)\to W$, the map $T$ is continuous if and only if $T|_{\mathscr D_K}$ is continuous for every compact $K\subseteq V$.
